Title: P01-01 · Pin container environment and toolchain
Notes: Image digest recorded in README. No step runs outside the container.

Title: P01-02 · Acquire AplCal3.0 and RefSeq Release 102
Notes: Record SHA-256 for all inputs in data/manifest.tsv. Capture assembly and annotation release strings verbatim.

Title: P01-03 · Acquire AplysiaTools and Orvis 2022 transcriptome
Notes: Confirm the AplysiaTools build and the GenBank TSA GJYY00000000 build are the same by sample comparison.

Title: P01-04 · BUSCO baseline on Release 102
Notes: metazoa_odb10. This is the 'before' arm of primary hypothesis H1.

Title: P01-05 · Per-locus fragmentation diagnostics
Notes: Exon count, CDS length, start/stop presence, gap overlap, internal-stop flag. Produces the paired locus table for T2 and T3.

Title: P01-06 · Cross-annotation BUSCO for Elysia and Euprymna
Notes: Contemporary peer baseline for test T4.

Title: P01-07 · GATE G1 — baseline adequacy review
Notes: If baseline metazoan BUSCO < 90% the paired comparison is void and scope drops to the channel subset only. Record and report.

Title: P01-08 · Liftoff lift-off of transcriptome onto AplCal3.0
Notes: DIAMOND + Liftoff, --flanks 10, Release 102 as --gff guide.

Title: P01-09 · GATE G2 — lift coverage review
Notes: If lifted fraction < 60% abandon the lift route and fall back to SRA remap + BRAKER3. This changes the compute budget and must not be a mid-project surprise.

Title: P01-10 · Transcriptome ORF prediction
Notes: aplotransDecoder. Generates candidate coding models absent from the genome annotation.

Title: P01-11 · Gene-model repair and reconciliation
Notes: Follow the Hsiao 2024 repair logic: MAFFT L-INS-i, trimAl, IQ-TREE 2, inspect multi-homolog branches, replace broken models. Never delete a Release 102 model — retire to a superseded track with reason.

Title: P01-12 · OrthoFinder and eggNOG-mapper
Notes: Orthology and functional annotation for the recovered models.

Title: P01-13 · Pfam and InterProScan channel-family sweep
Notes: Kv, K2P, KCNQ, Slo/BK, SK, HCN, CaV, Nav, ENaC, Na/K-ATPase, ligand-gated, IP3R, SERCA, Slack, TREK.

Title: P01-14 · Membrane topology prediction
Notes: DeepTMHMM for every catalogue entry.

Title: P01-15 · Dual-annotator manual curation queue
Notes: Two annotators classify the full review queue blind. Inter-rater agreement is test T9; target Cohen's kappa >= 0.80.

Title: P01-16 · Kappa analysis and third-annotator adjudication
Notes: Report kappa with bootstrap CI, raw confusion matrix, and per-family breakdown. A single global kappa can hide that one family is where all difficulty sits.

Title: P01-17 · Isoform analysis for key channel loci
Notes: Descriptive only, no test (T8). n is far too small for inference at this locus count.

Title: P01-18 · Enrichment and cross-species statistics
Notes: Tests T5 Poisson GLM on family counts, T6 hypergeometric enrichment with tested universe as background, T7 Fisher on ortholog retention.

Title: P01-19 · Statistical tests T1-T4 and T10
Notes: McNemar exact (BUSCO), Wilcoxon signed-rank exact (CDS length, exon count), chi-square/Fisher (cross-annotation), Welch t-test (sequence identity). All with effect sizes.

Title: P01-20 · Figure generation from scripts
Notes: Every figure has a matching script in src/figures/. No manual figure editing.

Title: P01-21 · Manuscript draft
Notes: Target Genome Research or G3. If both primary criteria fail the negative result is published — that outcome is in scope.

Title: P01-22 · Zenodo release and repository archive
Notes: Concept DOI, container digest, catalogue released CC0. reproduce.sh regenerates all figures from a clean clone.
